== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Shadeseeker is a sacred shark and a member of the [[Tidewalker sect]], holding the title of [[Uncrowned]]. She possesses advanced shapeshifting abilities that allow her to take on a nearly human appearance, though she retains certain shark-like features such as serrated teeth and a fin on her shoulder. In combat, she utilizes daggers composed of [[madra]] that combine elements of [[water]], [[blood]], and swords to create jagged, black-[[water]] fangs. She is the daughter of the leader of the [[Tidewalker sect]] and has been observed closely by [[Reigan Shen|Reigan]], a fellow [[Uncrowned]] member of the [[Shen tribe]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Shadeseeker is a shark-girl. She serves as the [[Uncrowned]] of the [[Tidewalkers]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|She utilizes a pair of jagged daggers in combat. Her [[madra]] is composed of elements involving [[water]], [[blood]], and swords.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Shadeseeker is a shark-girl who holds the title of [[Uncrowned]] of the [[Tidewalkers]]. As the daughter of a [[Herald]], she utilizes a unique [[madra]] that blends elements of [[blood]], [[water]], and swords. In combat, she wields a pair of jagged daggers to face her enemies. However, her efforts were ultimately thwarted when she fell victim to the schemes of [[Reigan Shen|Reigan]].}}
